Package com.microservices.warehouse.storages.services

Class BookmarkService

java.lang.Object
com.microservices.warehouse.storages.services.BookmarkService
@Service public class BookmarkService extends Object
This service class provides operations related to bookmarks, including persisting, deleting, and retrieving bookmarks. It interacts with the BookmarkRepository to perform CRUD operations and handle bookmark entities.

NOTE: All methods are transactional and handle various aspects of bookmark management.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Pouria Ghafarbeigi
